Contents:
Let it be knowne that the Lampsmiths of our generation have revised the Codex for our Lighter compatriots. It is in this codex that we dictate the lawes of our guild and tenets.

Our Primary tenet is civilization, people. The reason we light the roads, the reason we travel them and beat back beasts are for these two things. So that the people of this world may continue, regardless of faith or war between them, the beasts and monsters of this world should never overwhelm such.

Our guildes neutrality is paramount, we do not take part of conflicts between nations or religions. If your friend is attacked, tis understandable. But consider the guild afore stepping in, do not use this as an excuse to fight for your faithe or the government in place, thus ruining our neutralitie.

With that, let me alight you to things.

In the event of a brigands tollbooth, is this your job? No. That is the local forces duty and not yours. If somebody refuses pae toll, and tries to cross? That is their fault. This is man striking man, not beast mauling man.

In the event of local heretics or peoples hostile to the local government, kingdom, or ruling family. It is not your duty to intervene on either side, our guildes neutrality is the very reason we operate across the continent without issue.

Should somebody steal a Lamp-stave from one of your brothers or sisters, there is to be ZERO recourse given in reclaiming it. Kill, burn. Maim. Retrieve the stave, they are not only proprietary but these are the symbols of our guild.

Goblins, orcs, beasts, minotaurs, werebeasts, and other night creatures are to be burned back from the roads, it is not your duty to slay them all, merely push them back. In the case of Brigands, they are only to be combatted if they jump to violence immediatelie on travelers. Tollbooths are not your issue, nor are those who offer or talk without merely slaying anyone they come across. Faith? You may hold your faith, you do not kill over it. If it is offensive to the local rulers? Keep it to yourself, and symbols of faith hidden.

Roads must be kept lit clearly, wounded travelers or those dead found amongst them must be saved and returned to civlization, for this is the very basis of our duty.

The secrets to Lamptern Stave construction, or of our pyromancies are never to be given to outsiders, should one wish join our ranks they are to be pointed to the nearest enclave and it's Lamp-Smithe.

We are an Olde organization, young Lighter reading this. Our tenets are many and not every situation can be covered. It is the hope of the conclave as a whole that you follow your duties righteously, it is we who burn bright in the darkness. It is we who provide the worlde with it's beacons of lighte among the dark and winding roades.

So, do your best infer from this booke what is righte for what situation. Protect the road and defend civilization from the darkness that ever encroaches.
